model_datum.source: file label zeta {'standard_name': 'sea_surface_height_above_msl', 'long_name': 'water surface elevation above msl'}; consistent with SCN 26-51 (v3.1 station output referenced to LMSL)

obs_datum.source: [B-D2] CO-OPS datum for LMSL (CO-OPS API datum names)

texts: [B-D4] Model LMSL and CO-OPS MSL are both mean-sea-level datums and are treated as compatible, but their equivalence is not established: CO-OPS MSL is the tidal datum of the 1983-2001 National Tidal Datum Epoch [COOPSDAT], and NOAA does not state the epoch or realization of the model's LMSL [SCN26-51, NOMADS2D]. A mean offset (bias) can therefore include a reference difference; no vertical transformation was applied.
